actualFinding.title: Tarifkonflikte und Löhne
actualFinding.message: Goal uses applicability override for DE-HB, DE-TH.

individualScopeDecisions.rationale: HB/TH retain explicit direct prerequisiteOnly references as actual didactic prerequisites of the f93 whole endpoint; direct goalEntry specificity is authored, not an inferred target. The override permits this existing prerequisite use. No direct HB/TH official source or curricular target obligation is claimed.

actualFinding.title: Monopolistische Marktmacht als Marktversagen erklären
actualFinding.message: Goal uses applicability override for DE-BY, DE-NI.

individualScopeDecisions.rationale: BY WR11.1 imperfect competition is now independently qualified through two track-specific direct PARTIAL unions; NI has no bounded verified corresponding facet and its target plus full dependent offered practices are removed. Old own override remains canonical availability only; current source backing is measured separately.

actualFinding.title: Rechtsstaatsbezogene EU-Haushaltsmaßnahmen prüfen
actualFinding.message: Goal uses applicability override for DE-BE, DE-BY, DE-HE, DE-NI, DE-NW, DE-SH.

individualScopeDecisions.rationale: The supplied Art4–6 EU-budget norm application is intentionally owned didactic extension. All six unsupported country targets and their whole assessed practice offers are removed while canonical materials and national DE scope remain. The existing override is retained owned availability, not an official source obligation or source-evidence substitute.

actualFinding.title: Betriebliche Mitbestimmung erklären und beurteilen
actualFinding.message: Goal uses applicability override for DE-MV.

individualScopeDecisions.rationale: MV has no qualified actual ordinary source facet for the whole supplied workplace participation performance. The unsupported country target and coupled full practices are removed; legitimate source-bound country scopes and canonical material stay exact. Existing MV bound is only owned canonical availability, never evidence of required MV curriculum.

actualFinding.title: Herausforderungen der EWU
actualFinding.message: Goal uses applicability override for DE-NI.

individualScopeDecisions.rationale: NI foreign-trade original does not justify a whole EWU-crisis/reform performance. The unsupported NI target and coupled whole practice offers are removed; the owned compatibility bound remains without source or universal course claims.

actualFinding.title: Marktversagen durch Informationsasymmetrien erklären
actualFinding.message: Goal uses applicability override for DE-BB, DE-BY, DE-NI, DE-TH.

individualScopeDecisions.rationale: BY INFO is independently qualified only for WWG WR11.5 institution analysis/adverse selection; it is not an all-track obligation. BB/NI/TH targeted originals do not justify the whole information-selection mechanism, so those targets and coupled whole assessed offers are removed. Override availability alone grants no source coverage.

actualFinding.title: Entlohnungsformen perspektivisch beurteilen
actualFinding.message: Goal uses applicability override for DE-HH, DE-MV, DE-NW, DE-SH, DE-SN, DE-ST.

individualScopeDecisions.rationale: NW actualEF56/57 wage concepts plus efficiency/distribution judgment support one independently qualified PARTIAL union; its whole original ten-goal union stays exact. HH/MV/SH/SN/ST have no qualified current whole performance source for these retained owned targets and their coupled practice offers are removed. The bound is not a norm claim.

actualFinding.title: Externe Effekte analysieren
actualFinding.message: Goal uses applicability override for DE-BB.

individualScopeDecisions.rationale: BB GK19 environmental-economy relations support an independently qualified PARTIAL external-effects mechanism union. ActualLK26 is only the selected NachhaltigesWirtschaften alternative; the official text does not literally name external effects. Existing override supports this authored mechanism, without universal LK or whole original-source performance claims.

actualFinding.title: Armutsbekämpfung und Teilhabe
actualFinding.message: Goal uses applicability override for DE-BE, DE-NI.

individualScopeDecisions.rationale: BE/NI statistical, distribution and order facets do not by themselves justify the whole poverty-response and participation-strategy contract. Unsupported country targets and coupled whole assessed offers are removed; legitimate whole-source unions elsewhere and owned national material remain. Bounds are not source evidence.

actualFinding.title: Wirkungen flexibler Arbeitszeitmodelle analysieren
actualFinding.message: Goal uses applicability override for DE-BW, DE-HH, DE-NW, DE-SH, DE-SN, DE-ST.

individualScopeDecisions.rationale: NW actualLK79 wage/working-time redistribution and stability analysis supports one independently qualified PARTIAL flexible-hours union; wider existing original union remains exact. BW/HH/SH/SN/ST targets and coupled whole offers lack that actual performance source and are removed. Pure hours never replaces old whole work/pay facets.

actualFinding.title: Bereitstellungsprobleme öffentlicher Güter erklären
actualFinding.message: Goal uses applicability override for DE-BB, DE-BY, DE-TH.

individualScopeDecisions.rationale: BY WR11.1 explicitly names public goods and supports two independently qualified track-specific PARTIAL provision-mechanism unions. BB/TH targeted originals do not establish this separate mechanism and corresponding targets/whole assessed offers are removed. Bounds preserve owned canonical availability without Source-duty inference.
